headline: BI Records Budget Surplus of Rp117,8 T in September 2026
summary: Bank Indonesia recorded a Rp117.8 trillion surplus, which the input attributes to policies aimed at economic stability. The surplus will be transferred to the government under the central bank law.
why: Bank Indonesia is the country's central bank, and its surplus transfers add to government revenue.
original_headline: BI Cetak Surplus Anggaran Rp117,8 T di September 2026
